target.title: fix(agents): reject invalid goal token budgets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where agents using `create_goal` with malformed `token_budget` values such as `"42.9"` or `"1abc"` could create a goal with a truncated numeric budget instead of getting an invalid-input error.

## Why This Change Was Made

`create_goal` now advertises `token_budget` as an integer with a minimum of 1 and uses the shared strict positive-integer reader at the model-facing tool boundary. Invalid present values are rejected before any session goal is created, while valid positive integer budgets keep the existing goal creation path.

## User Impact

Goal token budgets now match the documented positive-budget contract, so agents cannot silently create goals with a different budget than the value they supplied.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: malformed and non-positive `create_goal.token_budget` values are rejected by the real model-facing tool invocation, `get_goal` reads back no goal after those invalid calls, and a valid positive integer budget still creates an active goal.
- Current-head real behavior proof at `01d0a7d9c957675317d6a44d6a31e118e50e2786`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` imported `createCreateGoalTool`, `createGetGoalTool`, `upsertSessionEntry`, and `resolveStorePath`, seeded an isolated temp session row, then invoked the real `create_goal` and `get_goal` tool executors.

```json
{
  "head": "01d0a7d9c957675317d6a44d6a31e118e50e2786",
  "proofPath": [
    "upsertSessionEntry",
    "createCreateGoalTool",
    "create_goal.execute",
    "createGetGoalTool",
    "get_goal.execute"
  ],
  "invalidResults": [
    {
      "tokenBudget": "42.9",
      "rejected": true,
      "message": "token_budget must be a positive integer"
    },
    {
      "tokenBudget": "1abc",
      "rejected": true,
      "message": "token_budget must be a positive integer"
    },
    {
      "tokenBudget": 0,
      "rejected": true,
      "message": "token_budget must be a positive integer"
    }
  ],
  "afterInvalid": {
    "hasGoal": false,
    "status": "missing"
  },
  "validCreate": {
    "status": "created",
    "tokenBudget": 42
  },
  "afterValid": {
    "hasGoal": true,
    "objective": "prove valid budget still works",
    "tokenBudget": 42,
    "status": "active"
  },
  "assertions": {
    "invalidRejected": true,
    "invalidMessages": true,
    "noGoalAfterInvalid": true,
    "validBudgetStillCreatesGoal": true
  }
}
```

- Focused regression proof at `01d0a7d9c957675317d6a44d6a31e118e50e2786`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/goal-tools.test.ts` passed with 1 test file and 6 tests.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
